> I was trying out some of the examples in Stan. The link for the

Thanks for reporting. I removed the links --- we don't have the
Asia model implemented.

If someone wants to implement it, it would require
marginalizing out all the discrete parameters. I think
it'd be possible because there are only 32 possibilities,
but it's a pain. I created an issue in case anyone wants
to do it and send us a pull request:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/517

- Bob
